title: Number of Common Factors
summary: For two positive integers a and b, determine the count of integers x that divide both a and b without remainder.
statement: For two positive integers a and b, determine the count of integers x that divide both a and b without remainder.
constraints: A common factor is a positive integer dividing both a and b.
Count distinct factor values, including one and the numbers themselves when applicable.
a and b are positive integers.
hints: Every common factor divides gcd(a,b), and every divisor of the gcd divides both inputs.
Compute the greatest common divisor first.
Count integers from one through the gcd that divide it evenly.
The divisor equivalence makes this count exactly the set of common factors.
editorial: The divisor equivalence makes this count exactly the set of common factors.

tests.explanation: The common factors are one, two, three, and six.
Only one and five divide both values.
